## Facebook replies — human review first
1. Deploy the ERP inbox endpoints and configure Meta webhook.
2. Create HTTP Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_ERP_TOKEN. Assign to all four ERP HTTP nodes. Required scopes: catalog:read, automation:read, automation:write.
3. Save OpenRouter key and model in ERP Settings > API & Automation.
4. Send one test Facebook message, run manually, and inspect the ERP review inbox.
5. Enable schedule only after end-to-end verification.

**No messages are sent. No orders are created.** Unknown product/ad context and invalid AI responses go to human handover. Execution history saving is disabled to avoid storing credentials. Do not pin settings outputs.
